subject: asp-es
title: ASP.ES.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 44 (SD(SY)-22). ASP-ES (aspect essence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From AFL-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From INFO-DE-B: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From IST-S-ALGN: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: MTA-IMP (meta-implications) and MT-TFS-AT (multi-transfer shift activity). From MTA-IMP: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MT-TFS-AT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: VT-ATT (vibrational attitude).
